title: The Lighthouse That Lost Its Keepers
description: In December 1900 a passing steamer noticed that the light at the Flannan Isles lighthouse, off Scotland, was out. When the relief ship finally arrived, the beds were unmade, the clock was unwound and the three keepers were gone, never to be found.
